title: Winter Wonderland Weekend
imageAlt: Winter Wonderland Weekend, 27 to 29 November 2026. Posters for the Layton Christmas Lights Switch-On, the Free Christmas Party at The Victory Pub and the StreetLife Festive Family Fun Day at Layton Institute.
summary: Four Christmas events across three days, from the Layton Lights Switch-On on Friday to a free community Christmas party on Sunday, with plenty of free fun along the way.
intro: Blackpool families have a packed Christmas weekend ahead, with four community events across Friday 27, Saturday 28 and Sunday 29 November.
paragraphs: Friday 27 November: the Layton Christmas Lights Switch-On on Westcliffe Drive. The event starts from 5:15pm and the lights go on at 6:15pm. There is a treasure hunt for the kids, live music, a brass band, stalls, special guests and a book giveaway, and it is free to attend.
Saturday 28 November, 12pm to 5:30pm: the Bloomfield Brewhouse Christmas Market, with festive stalls and free activities for children run by Blackpool STEM Club, including a Santa Zipline Challenge.

Saturday 28 November, 6pm to 10pm: the Condor Grove Christmas Lights Switch-On, with the main switch-on at 7pm. It raises funds for Fylde Kids Foundation, and promises Santa and Mrs Claus arriving by sleigh, live singers, the LIMITLESS girl band, stalls, mascots, hot food, a tombola, raffles and snow machines.

Sunday 29 November, 2pm to 5pm: a free Christmas party and community thank-you at The Victory Pub on Caunce Street, organised by Ameelia Unfiltered with Blackpool Mums & Babies, Mel Bee's and Solo Parents United. Entry, a disco, a buffet, face painting and Santa visits are free, and children get presents and chocolates from Santa. The party also supports a Christmas Present Drive, where donations are welcome but never expected.
Also in Layton that weekend: the Festive Family Fun Day at Layton Institute on Sunday from 1pm to 4pm, and the Music & Memory Social at Layton Library on Saturday morning.

title: Road closures for the Layton Christmas Lights Switch-On
imageAlt: Poster for the Layton Christmas Lights Switch-On on Friday 27th November 2026. Event starts from 5.15pm and the lights are switched on at 6.15pm, on Westcliffe Drive, Layton. Special guests, live music, stalls, treasure hunt, book give-away and a brass band. Organised by Layton Together and supported by Forward Project and your local councillors.
summary: Blackpool Council has confirmed temporary road closures around Layton Square on Friday 27 November, from 5pm to 7pm, for the Layton Christmas Lights Switch-On.
intro: Blackpool Council has confirmed temporary road closures around Layton Square for the Layton Christmas Lights Switch-On on Friday 27 November 2026.
paragraphs: The closures run from 5pm to 7pm. Drivers are asked to plan their journeys accordingly and to follow the road closure signs.
The organisers apologise for any inconvenience and thank local residents and businesses for their patience, understanding and support.
They look forward to welcoming everyone to a community Christmas celebration, with the event starting from 5:15pm and the lights switched on at 6:15pm.

title: Lay a Brick: build a future
imageAlt: Poster for the Lay a Brick campaign for the Layton Youth and Skills Hub. Lay a brick, build a future. Five pounds per brick. Sponsor a brick and receive your own thank-you certificate, with the option to have your name included in the Hall of Fame. Scan the QR code to sponsor a brick today. Other payment methods available on request. Layton Methodist Forward Project, Charity No. 1194986.
summary: A campaign to help build the new Layton Youth & Skills Hub, one £5 brick at a time. Around £270,000 of the £500,000 target is already secured.
intro: Layton Methodist Church and Forward Project have launched the Lay a Brick campaign to help build the new Layton Youth & Skills Hub.
paragraphs: Around £270,000 has already been secured towards a £500,000 target, and the campaign is asking the community to help with the rest.

For £5 per brick, supporters help create a space where local young people can meet, learn new skills and access opportunities. Anyone who gives their contact details receives a thank-you certificate, and can choose to have their name added to the Hall of Fame.
Donations are taken securely online through the campaign's fundraising partner, Give A Little. Other payment methods are available on request.
Every brick makes a difference, and sharing the campaign helps too.
